outcome: Ultrasound parameters (biparietal diameter, head circumference, abdominal circumference, femoral length)
Infant motor development (Alberta Infant Motor Scale)
cohort: 203 eligible participants admitted to the obstetrics department for labor
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus was significantly positively associated with numerous maternal and fetal perinatal parameters, including pre-pregnancy weight, obesity degree, weight at delivery, gestational weight gain, body mass index, glucose levels, family history of cardiovascular disease, pregnancy-related hypertension, congenital thrombophilia, drug use in pregnancy, large for gestational age, mode of delivery, ultrasound parameters, birth weight, newborn's head circumference, newborn's chest circumference, and infant motor development.
mod_finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus was significantly positively associated with Cesarean section and instrumental delivery.
